title: Contravariant composition of all attachment operators
statement: With K split, V a formal family, p a compatible boundary cone, and the explicit operators attachmentMap [def-weil-pbc-site-split-attachment-operators], for any q,r,s≤n+1 and ordinal maps α:[q]→[r], β:[r]→[s], the operator for α followed by β is attachmentMap(β) followed by attachmentMap(α). No finiteness or matching universal property is required.

source.place: Tags 0DAV (lemma-hypercovering-object), construction and omitted composition verification, and 0DAU (lemma-split); explicit normalized-coordinate expansion of the finite attachment argument.

proof.text: Split each of q,r,s into old degree or top degree. Old--old--old is K.map_comp. The other seven cases are respectively face naturality, lift-face, end-face, lift naturality, end-lift, lift-end and end composition from the explicit operator identities. Whisker each identity by the source and target equality transports; the intermediate inverse equality transports cancel. These eight cases exhaust all possible ordinal operators.

lean.statement: theorem attachmentMap_comp (K : SimplicialObject.Truncated (FormalCoproduct.{w} D) n) (hs : IsSplit K) (V : FormalCoproduct.{w} D) (p : BoundaryCone K V) (q r s : Fin (n + 2)) (α : SimplexCategory.mk q.val ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk r.val) (β : SimplexCategory.mk r.val ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk s.val) : attachmentMap K hs V p q s (α ≫ β) = attachmentMap K hs V p r s β ≫ attachmentMap K hs V p q r α
